sources.title: 2026 North Dakota Income Tax Withholding Rates and Instructions
North Dakota Income Tax Withholding and Information Returns Guideline

modernSteps: Annualize federal taxable wages using the payroll-period multiplier.
Apply the annual table for Federal Form W-4 Step 1(c) filing status.
Divide annual withholding by payroll periods and round to the nearest whole dollar.
legacySteps: Subtract the period allowance value multiplied by legacy allowances.
Apply the direct period Single or Married table and round to the nearest whole dollar.

rounding.minimumCalculatedWithholding: Amounts below $1 need not be withheld

supplementalWages.notSeparatelyIdentified: Apply an ordinary regular-wage method to the combined payment.
separatelyPaidOrIdentifiedMethods: Aggregate with current or most recent regular wages, calculate through the applicable W-4-generation method, and subtract regular withholding

residencyAndWorkRules.northDakotaServices: Withhold from wages subject to federal withholding for services performed in North Dakota unless an exemption applies.
residencyAndWorkRules.residentOutsideState: A North Dakota-based employer withholds for a North Dakota resident working in another state unless required to withhold that other state's income tax on the wages earned there.
residencyAndWorkRules.minnesotaAdditionalCondition: Minnesota resident must return to the permanent Minnesota residence at least once each month.
residencyAndWorkRules.employeeFormDue: February 28 or within 30 days after beginning work or changing permanent residence
residencyAndWorkRules.employerFormDue: March 31 for forms received by February 28

electronicQuarterlyTrigger: Third-party payroll service electronically files and remits federal withholding

captureWarnings: A pre-2020 federal W-4 remains a distinct live calculation branch with allowances; it must not be silently migrated to the modern method.
Minnesota reciprocity depends on a monthly return-to-residence fact and annual form deadlines, not residence code alone.
Complete wage-bracket matrices for both W-4 generations remain in the checksummed publication but are not transcribed.

review.requiredNextStep: Import both wage-table families, implement W-4-generation selection and reciprocity renewal state, then add example, bracket-boundary, allowance, supplemental, and form-deadline regressions.
